_comment: FEMA NFIP documents indexed by Vertex AI Search for grounding. All are US Government works published by FEMA (public domain). 'url' is a direct PDF link when one is known; FEMA occasionally moves files, so 'landing_page' is where to find the current edition by hand. 'file' is the name used in grounding/raw/ and in gs://BUCKET/grounding/fema/. fema.gov and floodsmart.gov block scripted downloads (403 bot protection), so where possible 'url' points at the same official text on govinfo.gov (U.S. Government Publishing Office).

documents.title: Standard Flood Insurance Policy - Dwelling Form (F-122)
documents.why: The policy wording itself: flood definition, what is covered, basement limits, exclusions, duties after a loss, proof of loss. Fetched from govinfo.gov (44 CFR Part 61, Appendix A(1) - the official Dwelling Form text); fema.gov returns 403 to scripted downloads.

documents.title: NFIP Claims Handbook (for policyholders)
documents.why: Plain-language steps after a flood: documenting damage, what to keep, proof of loss, appeals. Strongly recommended (it answers 'what should I keep / photograph?' questions the policy form does not), but not required: fema.gov blocks scripted downloads, so it usually has to be downloaded by hand, and grounding already works with the SFIP alone.

documents.title: NFIP Claims Manual
documents.why: How adjusters handle NFIP claims; background for 'what happens next' questions.

documents.title: NFIP Flood Insurance Manual
documents.why: Underwriting and coverage rules; useful for coverage-limit and deductible questions.
